e.title: GAMLSS（位置-尺度-形状的分布回归）
e.title_en: GAMLSS (distributional regression for location, scale and shape)
e.title_hk: GAMLSS（位置-尺度-形狀的分布回歸）
e.summary: 分布回归经典实现（CRAN 5.5-0）：条件分布的每个参数都用解释变量建模
e.summary_en: The canonical distributional regression implementation (CRAN 5.5-0): every parameter of the conditional distribution is modelled with explanatory variables
e.summary_hk: 分布回歸經典實現（CRAN 5.5-0）：條件分布的每個參數都用解釋變量建模
e.body:
GAMLSS（CRAN 5.5-0）实现 Rigby & Stasinopoulos (2005) 提出的**广义可加模型 for 位置、尺度与形状**：这是一套**分布回归（distributional regression）**框架——响应变量条件分布的**全部参数**（位置 μ、尺度 σ、偏度 ν、峰度 τ）都用解释变量建模，而不是像 GLM 那样只建模均值。因此它天然适配保险损失数据的三大特征：重尾、偏斜、零膨胀。依赖侧挂 gamlss.data、**gamlss.dist**（分布库，2026-09-10 仍在更新）与 nlme/parallel，Imports MASS、survival。对 RIAA：在保险定价里 GAMLSS 常被当作「**GLM 的直接升级**」——GLM 只让均值随风险因子变，GAMLSS 让整个分布随因子变，这正好是索赔频度-强度建模最需要的自由度（例如让免赔额只影响尺度、让车型影响尾部形状）；它与 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-distributional]]、[[insurance-zit-dglm]]（零膨胀分布回归）、[[insurance-gam]]、[[glm]]、[[tweedie]] 构成从经典到现代的完整谱系，其梯度提升版本见 [[gamboostlss]]，极值方向的同构思路见 [[evgam]]（GAM 形式的极值模型）；适合作定价、频度-强度建模与分布假设方向。说明：gamlss 与 gamlss.dist 属同一作者家族，本词条合并记录。

e.body_en:
GAMLSS (CRAN 5.5-0) implements the **generalized additive models for location, scale and shape** of Rigby and Stasinopoulos (2005): a **distributional regression** framework in which **every parameter** of the response’s conditional distribution (location μ, scale σ, skewness ν, kurtosis τ) is modelled with explanatory variables, rather than only the mean as in a GLM. That makes it a natural fit for the three defining features of insurance loss data: heavy tails, skewness and zero inflation. It depends on gamlss.data, **gamlss.dist** (the distribution library, still updated 2026-09-10), nlme and parallel, and Imports MASS and survival. For RIAA: in insurance pricing GAMLSS is often treated as **the direct upgrade from a GLM** — a GLM lets only the mean vary with rating factors, GAMLSS lets the whole distribution vary, which is exactly the extra freedom claim frequency-severity modelling needs (e.g. letting a deductible affect only the scale, or vehicle type affect the tail shape); it sits in a lineage from classical to modern alongside [[insurance-distributional-glm]], [[insurance-distributional]], [[insurance-zit-dglm]] (zero-inflated distributional regression), [[insurance-gam]], [[glm]] and [[tweedie]], with a gradient-boosting version in [[gamboostlss]] and a structurally similar idea for extremes in [[evgam]] (extreme value models in GAM form); suits pricing, frequency-severity modelling and distributional assumptions. Note: gamlss and gamlss.dist belong to the same author family and are recorded as one entry.

e.body_hk:
GAMLSS（CRAN 5.5-0）實現 Rigby & Stasinopoulos (2005) 提出的**廣義可加模型 for 位置、尺度與形狀**：這是一套**分布回歸**框架——響應變量條件分布的**全部參數**（位置 μ、尺度 σ、偏度 ν、峰度 τ）都用解釋變量建模，而不是像 GLM 那樣只建模均值。因此它天然適配保險損失數據的三大特徵：重尾、偏斜、零膨脹。依賴側掛 gamlss.data、**gamlss.dist**（分布庫，2026-09-10 仍在更新）與 nlme/parallel。對 RIAA：在保險定價裡 GAMLSS 常被當作「**GLM 的直接升級**」——GLM 只讓均值隨風險因子變，GAMLSS 讓整個分布隨因子變，這正是索賠頻度-強度建模最需要的自由度；與 [[insurance-distributional-glm]]、[[insurance-distributional]]、[[insurance-zit-dglm]]、[[insurance-gam]]、[[glm]]、[[tweedie]] 構成完整譜系，梯度提升版本見 [[gamboostlss]]，極值方向的同構思路見 [[evgam]]；適合作定價、頻度-強度建模與分布假設方向。說明：gamlss 與 gamlss.dist 屬同一作者家族，本詞條合併記錄。
